therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: BiTE (bispecific T-cell engager) antibody that redirects T-cells to CD19+ B-cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of ALL relapse post-transplant through targeted elimination of residual CD19+ leukemic cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia following allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants with toxicities (grade 3-4 acute GVHD >30%, secondary graft failure >30%, or nonrelapse mortality within one cycle)

results.dose_information: 28 µg/24 hours continuous IV infusion over 4 weeks, followed by 2-week treatment-free period. First cycle: 9 µg/day for 7 days, then escalated to 28 µg/day. 4 cycles total at 3, 6, 9, and 12 months post-HCT

context.duration: 4 cycles over 12 months post-transplant, with 1 year follow-up
